name: a definition whose guard can be walked around still publishes — rule-bypassable is a warning too
notes: Case 4.49. The twin of workflow-defined-accepts-a-def-the-advisory-warns-about, for the generalised advisory code. This def trips rule-bypassable and nothing else: a guarded "Doing" → "Done" edge sits beside an unguarded any-state → "Done". The engine never calls adviseWorkflowDef, and no advisory may ever enter validateWorkflowDef's array, because publish gates on that array being empty — an advisory that leaked into it would become a refusal without anyone editing a word of it.
